dog.description_text:
Meet Cece! 💕 This adorable young, medium-sized girl is as sweet as they come. Cece loves giving hugs and will happily show you just how much love she has to share.

She can be a little scared at first, and who can blame her? With some patience, kindness, and a little time to feel safe, Cece is sure to blossom into a wonderful companion. Once she trusts you, those sweet hugs make it all worthwhile!

Cece is ready to find someone who will give her the love and security she deserves. Come meet this precious girl and give Cece the forever home she's been waiting for! 🐾❤️
dog.name: Cece
